title: eCooking mini-grid model: electric cooking, tariff structure and the mini-grid viability gap in Rwanda and Kenya
description: Hourly dispatch, least-cost sizing and financial model for solar-battery mini-grids with electric cooking, used for the paper 'Cheaper kilowatt-hours, unviable projects' (African Energy Futures, Nairobi, 2026). Includes the full test-suite and the pipeline that regenerates every table and figure. Survey microdata are not included; see docs/DATA_ACCESS.md.
